notes: where: none = no equipment, home = everyday household items, gym = gym equipment. level: 1 gentle, 2 steady, 3 strong. met: approximate intensity (Compendium of Physical Activities ranges), used only for rough energy estimates.

exercises.name: March in place
exercises.cue: Lift your knees to a comfortable height and swing your arms.

exercises.name: Brisk walk
exercises.cue: Walk at a pace where you can talk but not sing.

exercises.name: Step jacks
exercises.cue: Step one foot out to the side as your arms rise, then step back. No jumping.

exercises.name: Shadow boxing
exercises.cue: Soft knees, light punches, keep moving your feet.

exercises.name: Dance break
exercises.cue: Put on a song you like and move however feels good.

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.cue: Land softly on the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: High knees
exercises.cue: Quick light steps, knees towards hip height.

exercises.name: Stair climbing
exercises.cue: Walk up at a steady pace, hold the rail, walk down slowly.
exercises.caution: Always keep a hand near the rail.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.cue: Squat, hands down, step or jump back to a plank, return, stand tall.

exercises.name: Chair sit-to-stand
exercises.cue: Feet flat, lean forward slightly and stand without using your hands if you can.

exercises.name: Calf raises
exercises.cue: Rise onto your toes slowly, pause, lower slowly. Hold a wall for balance.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.cue: Lie on your back, knees bent, press through your heels and lift your hips.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
exercises.cue: Sit back as if into a chair, chest up, knees following your toes.

exercises.name: Wall sit
exercises.cue: Slide down the wall until your knees are comfortably bent. Hold and breathe.

exercises.name: Step-ups
exercises.cue: Press through the whole foot on the step, stand tall, step down with control.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge
exercises.cue: Step back, lower your back knee towards the floor, push through your front heel.

exercises.name: Split squat
exercises.cue: Stand in a long stride and lower straight down. Hold a wall if you need.

exercises.name: Side lunge
exercises.cue: Step wide, sit into one hip, keep the other leg straight.

exercises.name: Single-leg bridge
exercises.cue: As a glute bridge, with one foot lifted. Keep your hips level.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.cue: Rest your back foot on the seat and lower your back knee.

exercises.name: Jump squat
exercises.cue: Squat, jump gently, land softly back into a squat.
exercises.caution: Skip if you have knee pain or downstairs neighbours.

exercises.name: Wall push-up
exercises.cue: Hands on the wall at shoulder height, body straight, bend your elbows.

exercises.name: Incline push-up
exercises.cue: The higher the surface, the easier it is. Keep a straight line from head to heels.

exercises.name: Knee push-up
exercises.cue: Knees down, straight line from head to knees, chest towards the floor.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.cue: Hands under shoulders, body in one line, lower with control.

exercises.name: Chair dips
exercises.cue: Hands on the seat edge, bend your elbows straight back, not out.
exercises.caution: Stop if your shoulders feel pinched.

exercises.name: Pike push-up
exercises.cue: Hips high in an upside-down V, lower your head towards the floor.

exercises.name: Decline push-up
exercises.kit: Feet on a step or sofa
exercises.cue: Feet raised behind you makes the push-up harder.

exercises.name: Superman hold
exercises.cue: Lie face down, lift your arms and chest a little, squeeze your shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Lying Y-T raises
exercises.cue: Face down, thumbs up, raise your arms into a Y, then a T.

exercises.name: Backpack row
exercises.kit: Backpack with books or water bottles
exercises.cue: Hinge forward with a flat back, pull the bag to your ribs.

exercises.name: Under-table row
exercises.cue: Lie under the table, grip the edge, pull your chest up with your body straight.
exercises.caution: Test the table is stable and won't tip first.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.cue: On your back, lower the opposite arm and leg slowly while your lower back stays down.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.cue: On hands and knees, reach the opposite arm and leg long. Pause, return.

exercises.name: Heel taps
exercises.cue: On your back with knees bent and lifted, tap one heel down at a time.

exercises.name: Knee plank
exercises.cue: Forearms and knees down, straight line from head to knees.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.cue: Forearms down, body long, squeeze your glutes, breathe normally.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.cue: On one forearm, hips lifted. Bend your bottom knee to make it easier.

exercises.name: Mountain climbers
exercises.cue: From a high plank, drive your knees in one at a time. Slow is fine.

exercises.name: Hollow hold
exercises.cue: Lower back pressed down, arms and legs long and just off the floor.

exercises.name: Single-leg balance
exercises.cue: Stand near a counter, lift one foot, find a steady point to look at.

exercises.name: Heel-to-toe walk
exercises.cue: Walk in a line, placing each heel directly in front of the other toes.

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.cue: On hands and knees, round your back, then gently arch it. Move with your breath.

exercises.name: Open book rotation
exercises.cue: Lie on your side, knees bent, open your top arm across to the other side.

exercises.name: Kneeling hip stretch
exercises.cue: Half-kneel, tuck your hips under, shift gently forward.

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.cue: Heel forward, hinge at the hips with a long back until you feel a gentle stretch.

exercises.name: Doorway chest opener
exercises.cue: Forearms on the door frame, step through gently until your chest opens.

exercises.name: Gentle neck stretch
exercises.cue: Ear towards shoulder, shoulders relaxed. No rolling or forcing.

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.cue: Knees wide, sit back towards your heels, arms long, let your breath slow.

exercises.name: Legs up the wall
exercises.cue: Lie with your hips near the wall and rest your legs up it.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.cue: Hold the weight at your chest, sit down between your heels.

exercises.name: Barbell back squat
exercises.cue: Bar on upper back, brace, sit down to a comfortable depth, drive up.
exercises.caution: Set the safety bars. Ask staff for a form check if you're new.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.cue: Feet shoulder-width, lower until knees are comfortably bent, don't lock out hard.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Soft knees, push hips back, weights slide down your thighs, flat back.

exercises.name: Trap bar deadlift
exercises.cue: Stand inside the bar, brace, push the floor away.

exercises.name: Hip thrust
exercises.cue: Upper back on the bench, drive hips up, pause at the top.

exercises.name: Leg curl
exercises.cue: Curl smoothly, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.cue: Shoulder blades back, lower to chest level, press up.

exercises.name: Barbell bench press
exercises.cue: Feet planted, bar to lower chest, press up and slightly back.
exercises.caution: Use safety arms or a spotter.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shoulder press
exercises.cue: Press overhead without arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.cue: Pull the bar to your upper chest, elbows down and back.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.cue: Sit tall, pull the handle to your stomach, squeeze shoulder blades.

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row
exercises.cue: Hand and knee on the bench, row the weight to your hip.

exercises.name: Pull-up (assisted if needed)
exercises.cue: Start from a dead hang, pull your chest towards the bar.

exercises.name: Cable face pull
exercises.cue: Pull the rope towards your face, hands apart, elbows high.

exercises.name: Farmer's carry
exercises.cue: Stand tall, walk slowly with a heavy weight in each hand.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swing
exercises.cue: Hinge at the hips and snap them forward. Arms just guide the bell.

exercises.name: Incline treadmill walk
exercises.cue: Moderate incline, comfortable pace, try not to hold the rails.

exercises.name: Rowing machine
exercises.cue: Legs, then lean back, then arms. Reverse on the way in.

exercises.name: Exercise bike
exercises.cue: Steady effort where you can still talk.

routines.name: Desk break
routines.when: Between tasks or after a long sit

routines.name: Morning wake-up
routines.when: Before breakfast or after opening the curtains

routines.name: Quiet living-room cardio
routines.when: No jumping, so it's flat- and neighbour-friendly

routines.name: Stair session
routines.when: When you have stairs and 15 minutes

routines.name: Core in ten
routines.when: On its own or after a walk

routines.name: Bodyweight challenge
routines.when: When you want a real push

routines.name: Steady and strong
routines.when: Balance and leg strength, especially as we get older

routines.name: Gym full body A
routines.when: Beginners: alternate A and B, 2–3 times a week

routines.name: Gym upper body
routines.when: 4-day plan: upper, lower, rest, upper, lower

routines.name: Easy gym cardio
routines.when: Recovery days or after a short night
